alex: Hey team — alex here, joining today! :wave: Trying to follow the runtime README on Ubuntu 22.04 with an A100. CMake config completes but final link fails with an undefined reference to cublasLt.

alex: Link output:
```
[100%] Linking CXX executable bin/redwood_runtime
/usr/bin/ld: undefined reference to `cublasLtCreate'
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
```

alex: nvcc --version -> CUDA 11.8; nvidia-smi -> Driver 535. Any quick triage steps? Who owns infra driver stuff? @jamie @riley

jamie: welcome! :tada: quick checklist:
- confirm /usr/local/cuda points to the CUDA you expect or set -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH explicitly
- run `sudo ldconfig` after installs
- try the dev container: `docker run --gpus all -it --rm -v $PWD:/src redwood/runtime-dev:cuda11.8 /bin/bash`

riley: also check kernel headers. If driver was updated without headers, libs can be mislinked. Commands I usually run:
```
sudo apt install linux-headers-$(uname -r)
sudo apt-get install --reinstall nvidia-driver-535
```
And make sure CMake found libcublasLt.so under the cuda lib dir.

morgan: run `ldd bin/redwood_runtime | grep cublas` to see if any cublas libs are "not found". Also `ls /usr/local/cuda-11.8/lib64 | grep cublasLt` to verify the file exists.

alex: Is libcublasLt a separate link target we need to add manually? Our CMake uses find_package(CUDA) but maybe misses newer libs.

riley: libcublasLt is separate as libcublasLt.so but packaged with CUDA. Link failures usually mean cmake picked up headers but not libs (e.g., stray /usr/local/cuda symlink). Check `readlink -f /usr/local/cuda` and the lib path.

infra-bot: CI Notice: PR #3429 runtime-build (linux/cuda) failed on link step — target: redwood_runtime — logs: https://ci.internal/3429

alex: quick update — used jamie's container and also rebuilt with `-DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=/usr/local/cuda-11.8` and exported `LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/cuda-11.8/lib64:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH`. Re-ran cmake/make and the link succeeded. :raised_hands:

jamie: awesome! :100: we have a small doc in docs/dev-setup.md about removing old cuda symlinks and workflows for switching toolkits. Ping me if you want to pair through running the runtime smoke tests.

alex: thanks everyone — tagging as solved for my first-day checklist. :)
